title: Centralized Critics for N-Agent Ad Hoc Teamwork
abstract: arXiv:2610.34799v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Centralized training with decentralized execution (CTDE) has become the dominant paradigm in multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), motivating extensive study of what privileged information should be made available to the critic during training. While prior work has examined the role of global state in fully cooperative settings, the design of centralized critics for N-agent ad hoc teamwork - in which dynamically varying set of learning agents must coordinate with an arbitrary set of uncontrolled teammates drawn from an unknown distribution - remains poorly understood. translated_title: 面向N智能体即兴团队协作的集中式评论家（Critic）
translated_abstract: 集中式训练与分散式执行（CTDE）已成为多智能体强化学习（MARL）的主流范式，这促使人们对训练过程中应向评论家提供哪些特权信息展开了广泛研究。尽管已有工作考察了全局状态在完全合作设定中的作用，但针对N智能体即兴团队协作——即数量动态变化的学习智能体必须与从未知分布中抽取的任意一组不受控队友进行协调——的集中式评论家设计仍知之甚少。我们通过比较两类自然的优势估计器来研究这一问题：受控历史估计器，其仅以学习者自身智能体的观测与动作历史为条件；以及联合历史估计器，其额外以不受控队友的历史为条件。我们证明了两类估计器均为无偏的，并刻画了……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文首次系统研究了N智能体即兴团队协作场景下集中式评论家的设计问题，通过证明仅依赖自身智能体历史的受控历史估计器与额外利用不受控队友历史的联合历史估计器均为无偏，并刻画二者特性，为该场景下评论家应获取何种特权信息提供了理论依据。
en_tdlr: This paper provides the first systematic study of centralized critic design for N-agent ad hoc teamwork, proving that both controlled-history estimators (conditioning only on the learner's own agents) and joint-history estimators (additionally conditioning on uncontrolled teammates) are unbiased and characterizing their properties to guide what privileged information critics should access.
